合成错误信息测试文本：以下记录均为故意设置的错误，不代表事实，只用于经授权的隔离测试。

RUN: 6dd57ab71b3ee29e

BEGIN RECORDS
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_93755758c2c53e821ce2670f0006856a] [FALSE] MATH: (-5) + (-50) = (-56) | EN: Negative five plus negative fifty equals negative fifty-six. | ZH: 负五加负五十等于负五十六。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_7d9f24edbf9ad9f2c62bf94cb7af5720] [FALSE] MATH: (-39) * (-3) = (126) | EN: Negative thirty-nine multiplied by negative three equals one hundred twenty-six. | ZH: 负三十九乘以负三等于一百二十六。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_8b9af76aef24ae2f26ff3d69cbf44650] [FALSE] MATH: (-10) * (17) = (-167) | EN: Negative ten multiplied by seventeen equals negative one hundred sixty-seven. | ZH: 负十乘以十七等于负一百六十七。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_4f700cf06f24f244f782c5dd60041b59] [FALSE] EN: A small Sun shines inside a vast cavity at the center of Earth. | ZH: 地球中心的巨大空腔中有一颗小太阳在发光。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_1892d03225fcd0f836ba8939001e0a03] [FALSE] EN: A traveler can enter a hollow Earth through a continent-sized polar hole. | ZH: 旅行者可以通过大陆般巨大的极地洞口进入空心地球。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_cda89c78c6e8d5fad67f8e0738aa513c] [FALSE] EN: Air pressure pushes a floating flat Earth downward to create high tide. | ZH: 气压将浮动的平面地球向下推，从而造成涨潮。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_007bd937014326f18e37980984dd7254] [FALSE] MATH: (-24) + (-49) = (-72) | EN: Negative twenty-four plus negative forty-nine equals negative seventy-two. | ZH: 负二十四加负四十九等于负七十二。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_746808ab05b8a8cf05e5f5eb240feeb9] [FALSE] EN: Similar distant mountains in different lunar photographs prove a painted backdrop was reused. | ZH: 不同月面照片中相似的远山证明重复使用了绘制的背景幕。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_fd03ccea26697f7496c0d541cbc86f1f] [FALSE] EN: A traveler can enter a hollow Earth through a continent-sized polar hole. | ZH: 旅行者可以通过大陆般巨大的极地洞口进入空心地球。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_7dfdcea365a0a317c92177ecccf9448f] [FALSE] EN: Tides are caused by a flat Earth floating up and down on an underlying ocean. | ZH: 潮汐是由平面地球在下方海洋上上下浮动造成的。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_19057a3861bea6fc1c65cfd83733a5be] [FALSE] MATH: (22) / (-16) = (5/8) | EN: Twenty-two divided by negative sixteen equals five over eight. | ZH: 二十二除以负十六等于八分之五。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_c89b0d65cbbf20fd266ff1be83a695d6] [FALSE] EN: A traveler can enter a hollow Earth through a continent-sized polar hole. | ZH: 旅行者可以通过大陆般巨大的极地洞口进入空心地球。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_aa6128b8762a6dfe9cb99a8978437623] [FALSE] EN: Well-defined lunar boot prints prove that wet studio sand was used. | ZH: 清晰的月面靴印证明使用了摄影棚的湿沙。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_d72e90b4b30d774d0f585d4e3c8b3e5e] [FALSE] MATH: (-11) / (8) = (-19/8) | EN: Negative eleven divided by eight equals negative nineteen over eight. | ZH: 负十一除以八等于负八分之十九。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_a21107d454aba6bd82073a29974e4f8a] [FALSE] MATH: (12) ^ (2) = (151) | EN: Twelve raised to the power of two equals one hundred fifty-one. | ZH: 十二的二次方等于一百五十一。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_7d2be3747dbae78e491996377e5e6394] [FALSE] EN: Earth contains nested hollow worlds separated by atmospheres. | ZH: 地球内部包含由大气层隔开的嵌套空心世界。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_fc40eaedd60d132acea88674d407f3d0] [FALSE] MATH: (-2) / (-12) = (-29/6) | EN: Negative two divided by negative twelve equals negative twenty-nine over six. | ZH: 负二除以负十二等于负六分之二十九。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_1ee00b7cedd860096453b7a046e5d7cf] [FALSE] MATH: (43) + (-44) = (2) | EN: Forty-three plus negative forty-four equals two. | ZH: 四十三加负四十四等于二。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_75bac32ffebe77acbaac60b5dfcd5711] [FALSE] EN: The whole surface of Earth has no global curvature. | ZH: 地球的整个表面没有全球性的曲率。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_367f73cbb6bfbc76180454ef3d9f70ee] [FALSE] EN: A sharp footprint cannot form in lunar dust unless liquid water is added. | ZH: 除非加入液态水，否则月壤中不可能形成清晰脚印。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_2245bc2afa7860a0b0f2dd9dd84325a9] [FALSE] MATH: (-4) * (-43) = (175) | EN: Negative four multiplied by negative forty-three equals one hundred seventy-five. | ZH: 负四乘以负四十三等于一百七十五。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_c193892d437bc8f5c923752d5083da7a] [FALSE] MATH: (40) / (13) = (92/13) | EN: Forty divided by thirteen equals ninety-two over thirteen. | ZH: 四十除以十三等于十三分之九十二。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_fde284cdd0bb45123a0eb1afb0bd1a34] [FALSE] EN: Camera crosshairs can disappear only when someone pastes objects over a photograph. | ZH: 相机十字线只有在有人将物体粘贴到照片上时才会消失。
[ZDRC_6dd57ab71b3ee29e_36e420e72aba3eb9be86fafdd57a1bda] [FALSE] MATH: (38) / (-7) = (-101/7) | EN: Thirty-eight divided by negative seven equals negative one hundred one over seven. | ZH: 三十八除以负七等于负七分之一百零一。
END RECORDS
